title: Topical Amphotericin B in 30% Dimethylsulphoxide in Treating of Non-dermatophytes Onychomycosis
brief_summary: The randomized control trial study aimed to evaluate effectiveness and safety of amphotericin B in 30% DMSO solution comparing with 30% DMSO solution in NDMs onychomycosis treatment.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Patients with non-dermatophyte onychomycosis.
2. Patients aged more than 18 years.
3. Patients has not been treated with any oral/ IV/ topical antifungal therapy within 36 weeks before enrolled.

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Patients had concomitant nail diseases.
2. Immunocompromised host.
3. Patients with dermatophyte onychomycosis.
